caption: Figure 5.15 A representative diagram of human genome project
note: Caption is printed over two lines ("Figure 5.15 A representative diagram of human" / "genome project"); joined. The figure is a flow of four drawings (a girl, a cell, a chromosome, a DNA helix, then a computer) with only two labelled regions, so labels are given region by region following the printed arrows rather than strictly interleaved by line: first the DNA helix read top to bottom (ten base-pair labels GC AT AT GC TA CG AT GC TA CG, then the eight single letters on the two separated strands, left-then-right per rung: A T, T A, G C, T A), then the two lines on the computer screen (TGTAC, GTACA). The helix letters are printed very small; they were read by magnifying the crop and are legible. Crop over-includes one body line above the figure ("...ited for developing method for", clipped at the left margin) and a sliver of an orange margin rule at the right; both excluded.
